50	    (hp : D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
51	    ∃ h : B, h ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B, h ∉ q.asIdeal →
52	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] q.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
53	  have hp' : Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
54	    (D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton p.asIdeal.ResidueField).mp hp

38	theorem exists_glue_of_awaySpan {m : Nat} (f : Fin m -> S)
39	    (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤)
40	    (F : forall p : Fin m, DivFamZarAff C (Localization.Away (f p)) n)
41	    (hcompat : forall p q : Fin m,
42	      mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q) (F p) =

45	      mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p))) F0 = F p := by

48	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>

113	      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f l.down))) (fun _ => rfl) F,

125	    ∃! F0 : DivFamZarAff C S n, forall p : Fin m,
126	      mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p))) F0 = F p := by
127	  obtain ⟨F0, hF0⟩ := exists_glue_of_awaySpan f hspan F hcompat

129	    eq_of_awaySpan_eq f hspan (fun p => (hF1 p).trans (hF0 p).symm)⟩
130	
131	end DivFamZarAff

9	/-!
10	# From pointwise away-certificates to a span-`⊤` family
11	
12	`DivSchemeCertZarSeed.lean` reduced the DD-R certificate gate to *away-local* certificates
13	over a span-`⊤` family.  The geometry that produces such certificates, however, is
14	pointwise on the base: the support tube (`Scheme.LocalEquations.exists_supportTube`)
15	isolates the pieces over a Zariski neighbourhood **of one base point at a time**, and the
16	fibre analyses all read at a single `p : PrimeSpectrum R`.
17	
18	This file closes that gap with the quasi-compactness step.  If for every prime `p` there
19	is some `r ∉ p` over whose away localization the system is certified, then the good
20	elements span the unit ideal (their basic opens cover `Spec R`), so finitely many of them
21	already do — and `isLocallyCertified_of_forall_exists_away` applies.
22	
23	The result is that the certificate gate for the DD-R endgame is now genuinely *pointwise*:
24	one base point at a time, exactly the shape the landed fibre machinery delivers.
25	
26	## Main declarations
27	
28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_exists_away` — the pointwise gate
29	  for a bare local-equation system.
30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.ThetaGeneratorSeed.isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_away_certified`
31	  — the seed form.
32	-/
33	
34	set_option autoImplicit false
35	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
36	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
37	
38	universe u
39	
40	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
41	
42	namespace AlgebraicGeometry

44	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
45	
46	/-! ## The quasi-compactness step -/
47	
48	section SpanTop
49	
50	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
51	
52	/-- **Pointwise good elements span the unit ideal, finitely.** If a predicate `P` on `R`
53	holds at some element outside each prime, then finitely many elements satisfying `P` span
54	`⊤`.  This is quasi-compactness of `Spec R` in the elementary form the certificate gate
55	needs: the basic opens of the good elements cover the spectrum, hence the good set spans
56	the unit ideal, hence `1` is a finite combination of good elements. -/
57	theorem exists_fin_span_eq_top_of_forall_prime (P : R → Prop)
58	    (h : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, ∃ r, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ P r) :
59	    ∃ (m : ℕ) (g : Fin m → R), Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤ ∧ ∀ i, P (g i) := by
60	  classical
61	  -- the good elements span the unit ideal, because their basic opens cover `Spec R`
62	  have hspan : Ideal.span {r : R | P r} = ⊤ := by
63	    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top_iff']
64	    refine top_le_iff.mp fun p _ => ?_
65	    obtain ⟨r, hrp, hrP⟩ := h p
66	    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨r, by
67	      simpa only [Opens.mem_iSup, PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen] using ⟨hrP, hrp⟩⟩
68	  -- `1` is then a finite combination of good elements
69	  have hone : (1 : R) ∈ Submodule.span R {r : R | P r} := by
70	    show (1 : R) ∈ Ideal.span {r : R | P r}
71	    rw [hspan]; exact Submodule.mem_top
72	  obtain ⟨T, hTsub, hT⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_finite_of_mem_span hone
73	  refine ⟨T.card, fun i => (T.equivFin.symm i : R), ?_, fun i => hTsub (T.equivFin.symm i).2⟩
74	  have hrange : Set.range (fun i : Fin T.card => ((T.equivFin.symm i : R))) = (T : Set R) := by
75	    ext x
76	    constructor
77	    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
78	      exact (T.equivFin.symm i).2
79	    · intro hx
80	      exact ⟨T.equivFin ⟨x, hx⟩, by simp⟩
81	  rw [hrange]
82	  exact Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ hT isUnit_one
83	
84	end SpanTop

86	/-! ## The pointwise certificate gate -/
87	
88	section Pointwise
89	
90	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
91	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
92	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]
93	
94	/-- **The pointwise certificate gate.** If over every prime of the base there is an away
95	localization carrying a certified family divisor-equal to the pulled system, the system is
96	locally certified.  Combines the quasi-compactness step with the span-`⊤` production rule
97	`isLocallyCertified_of_forall_exists_away`. -/
98	theorem isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_exists_away {n : ℕ}
99	    {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
100	    (h : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, ∃ r, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
101	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
102	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
103	      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (Localization.Away r) pi n,
104	        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
105	          (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r))
106	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
107	              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) d))) :
108	    IsLocallyCertified C R pi n d := by
109	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hgood⟩ := exists_fin_span_eq_top_of_forall_prime
110	    (fun r =>
111	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
112	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
113	      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (Localization.Away r) pi n,
114	        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
115	          (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r))
116	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
117	              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) d))) h
118	  exact isLocallyCertified_of_forall_exists_away g hg hgood
119	
120	end Pointwise
121	
122	namespace ThetaGeneratorSeed
123	
124	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsProper C.hom]
125	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
126	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
127	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
128	variable {a n : ℕ} {K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R pi a)}
129	variable {D : ThetaGeneratorSeed C R pi a K}
130	
131	omit [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
132	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
133	
134	/-- **The pointwise certificate gate for a seed.** One base point at a time: an away
135	localization at each prime carrying a certified family divisor-equal to the pulled seed
136	system makes the seed's system locally certified, hence a `DivFamZar` class.
137	
138	This is the shape the landed geometry actually produces — the support tube isolates pieces
139	over a neighbourhood of one base point, and every fibre analysis reads at a single prime —
140	so no globally valid no-leak hypothesis (false in general, I-0209) is required anywhere. -/
141	theorem isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_away_certified (hD : D.IsGenerator)
142	    (h : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, ∃ r, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
143	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
144	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
145	      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (Localization.Away r) pi n,
146	        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
147	          ((D.localEquations hD).pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r))
148	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
149	              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) (D.localEquations hD)))) :
150	    IsLocallyCertified C R pi n (D.localEquations hD) :=
151	  isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_exists_away h
152	
153	/-- **The gate in its most consumable form: certify the pulled system after shrinking.**
154	At every prime it suffices to produce an `r ∉ p` and a certificate for *some* adaptation
155	of the pulled seed system over `Localization.Away r`.  The adaptation itself is free
156	(`exists_divisorAdaptation`), so the only genuine obligation is the certificate over the
157	shrunken base — where the support tube makes per-piece isolation available.
158	
159	Contrast with the old gate `divisorAdaptation_isCertified_of_noLeak_kernel_spanning`,
160	which demanded a certificate for the *canonically extracted* adaptation over the whole
161	chart ring; that shape forces a globally valid no-leak hypothesis, which is false. -/
162	theorem isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_exists_certified_adaptation
163	    (hD : D.IsGenerator)
164	    (h : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, ∃ r, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
165	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
166	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
167	      ∃ A : DivisorAdaptation C (Localization.Away r) pi
168	          ((D.localEquations hD).pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r))
169	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
170	              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) (D.localEquations hD))),
171	        A.IsCertified n) :
172	    IsLocallyCertified C R pi n (D.localEquations hD) := by
173	  refine isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_away_certified hD fun p => ?_
174	  obtain ⟨r, hrp, A, hA⟩ := h p
175	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
176	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
177	  -- bundle the supplied adaptation and its certificate; the divisor equality is `rfl`
178	  exact ⟨r, hrp, ⟨_, A, hA⟩, Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl _⟩
179	
180	/-- The `DivFamZar` class of a seed certified pointwise on the base. -/
181	noncomputable def divFamZar_of_forall_prime_away_certified (hD : D.IsGenerator)
182	    (h : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, ∃ r, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
183	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
184	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
185	      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (Localization.Away r) pi n,
186	        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
187	          ((D.localEquations hD).pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r))
188	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
189	              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) (D.localEquations hD)))) :
190	    DivFamZar C R pi n :=
191	  DivFamZar.mk (D.localEquations hD)
192	    (isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_away_certified hD h)
193	
194	end ThetaGeneratorSeed
195	
196	end AlgebraicGeometry

11	/-!
12	# T5 core — uniqueness of the divisor family in a rank-one datum class
13	
14	The localization-free heart of the `RankOneDivisorUniqueness` discharge: over an arbitrary
15	test algebra `B` carrying a pinned cocycle datum whose `H⁰` is finite, projective, and of
16	stalk rank one, **at most one** widened locally certified divisor family of degree
17	`genus C` has Picard class the datum's Čech class
18	(`divFamZarAff_eq_of_picClass_eq_cechPicClass`).
19	
20	The proof is the assembly of the three landed engines, with no localization anywhere:
21	
22	* T3 (`exists_gluedSection_sectionLocalEquations_divEq`) cuts each family, up to `DivEq`,
23	  from a germ-regular global section of the datum's glued sheaf;
24	* T4 (`tmul_residueField_ne_zero_of_divEq_certified`) makes the two `H⁰` classes
25	  fibrewise-nonzero at every prime of the base;
26	* the rank-one unit-extraction engine
27	  (`Module.existsUnique_unit_smul_of_forall_tmul_ne_zero`) then exhibits the second `H⁰`
28	  class as a global unit multiple of the first, and the unit-rescaling law
29	  (`sectionLocalEquations_smul_divEq`) transports the cut divisors into each other.
30	
31	The `DivEq` chain `d₁ ∼ cut(s₁) ∼ cut(v·s₁) = cut(s₂) ∼ d₂` closes equality in the
32	`DivFamZarAff` quotient (`mk_eq_mk_iff`).
33	
34	This is the exact reason injectivity is restored on the rank-one locus — single-point
35	linear systems — as demanded by the uniqueness-discharge memory (I-1981, trap 2): the
36	rank-one hypotheses enter irreplaceably through the unit-extraction engine, and nothing
37	here restates the uniqueness goal as a hypothesis.  The remaining (localizing) work of the
38	discharge — matching each family's class to a presentation datum near every prime — is the
39	per-prime base-discrepancy assembly, not this file.
40	-/
41	
42	set_option autoImplicit false
43	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
44	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
45	
46	universe u
47	
48	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
49	open scoped TensorProduct
50	
51	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
52	
53	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
54	
55	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
56	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
57	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
58	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
59	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k}
60	
61	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
62	
63	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
64	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
65	/-- Equal glued sections cut equal local-equation systems (the germ-regularity witnesses
66	are proof-irrelevant). -/
67	private lemma sectionLocalEquations_congr [IsAffineHom pi]
68	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
69	    {s s' : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤)} (hss' : s = s')
70	    (𝒲 : (relCurve C B).PointedCover) (σ : relCurve C B → D.index)
71	    (hσ : ∀ x : relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ x))
72	    (hreg : ∀ (j : D.index) (x : relCurve C B) (hx : x ∈ D.pieces j),
73	      ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) x hx).hom (D.component s j)
74	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk x))
75	    (hreg' : ∀ (j : D.index) (x : relCurve C B) (hx : x ∈ D.pieces j),
76	      ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) x hx).hom (D.component s' j)
77	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk x)) :
78	    D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg = D.sectionLocalEquations s' 𝒲 σ hσ hreg' := by
79	  cases hss'
80	  rfl
81	
82	/-- **Uniqueness of the divisor family in a rank-one datum class** (the T5 core, with no
83	localization): over an arbitrary test algebra whose pinned cocycle datum has `H⁰` finite,
84	projective, and of stalk rank one at every prime, two widened locally certified divisor
85	families of degree `genus C` with Picard class the datum's Čech class are equal.
86	
87	The two families are cut from `H⁰` classes of the datum (T3); both classes are
88	fibrewise-nonzero at every prime (T4), so the rank-one engine makes the second a global
89	unit multiple of the first, and unit rescaling does not move the cut divisor. -/
90	theorem divFamZarAff_eq_of_picClass_eq_cechPicClass [IsFinite pi]
91	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
92	    (hH1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 1))
93	    (hfin : Module.Finite B (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0))
94	    (hproj : Module.Projective B (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0))
95	    (hrank : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum B,
96	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p = 1)
97	    (F₁ F₂ : DivFamZarAff C B (genus C))
98	    (h₁ : F₁.picClass = D.cechPicClass)
99	    (h₂ : F₂.picClass = D.cechPicClass) :
100	    F₁ = F₂ := by
101	  classical
102	  haveI := hfin
103	  haveI := hproj
104	  induction F₁ using Quotient.ind with | _ x₁ => ?_
105	  induction F₂ using Quotient.ind with | _ x₂ => ?_
106	  obtain ⟨d₁, hd₁⟩ := x₁
107	  obtain ⟨d₂, hd₂⟩ := x₂
108	  have h₁' : d₁.picClass = D.cechPicClass := h₁
109	  have h₂' : d₂.picClass = D.cechPicClass := h₂
110	  -- T3: cut both families from glued sections
111	  obtain ⟨s₁, hreg₁, hdiv₁⟩ := D.exists_gluedSection_sectionLocalEquations_divEq d₁ h₁'
112	  obtain ⟨s₂, hreg₂, hdiv₂⟩ := D.exists_gluedSection_sectionLocalEquations_divEq d₂ h₂'
113	  -- realize the sections as `H⁰` classes
114	  obtain ⟨y₁, rfl⟩ : ∃ y, Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
115	      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
116	      isTerminalTop D.sheaf y = s₁ :=
117	    ⟨(Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀ _ isTerminalTop D.sheaf).symm s₁,
118	      (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀ _ isTerminalTop D.sheaf).apply_symm_apply s₁⟩
119	  obtain ⟨y₂, rfl⟩ : ∃ y, Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
120	      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
121	      isTerminalTop D.sheaf y = s₂ :=
122	    ⟨(Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀ _ isTerminalTop D.sheaf).symm s₂,
123	      (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀ _ isTerminalTop D.sheaf).apply_symm_apply s₂⟩
124	  set e₀ := Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
125	    (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
126	    isTerminalTop D.sheaf with he₀
127	  -- T4: both `H⁰` classes are fibrewise-nonzero at every prime
128	  have hH1' : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1 :=
129	    (subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff D).mpr hH1
130	  have hq₁ : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum B,
131	      (y₁ ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
132	        Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0 ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0 :=
133	    fun p => D.tmul_residueField_ne_zero_of_divEq_certified hH1' y₁
134	      D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex (fun _ => le_rfl) hreg₁ hd₁
135	      (hdiv₁ D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex fun _ => le_rfl) p
136	  have hq₂ : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum B,
137	      (y₂ ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
138	        Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0 ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0 :=
139	    fun p => D.tmul_residueField_ne_zero_of_divEq_certified hH1' y₂
140	      D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex (fun _ => le_rfl) hreg₂ hd₂
141	      (hdiv₂ D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex fun _ => le_rfl) p
142	  -- the rank-one engine: the second class is a global unit multiple of the first
143	  obtain ⟨v, hv, -⟩ := Module.existsUnique_unit_smul_of_forall_tmul_ne_zero
144	    (B := B) (Q := Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) hrank y₁ y₂ hq₁ hq₂
145	  -- transport the unit through the sections and chain the divisor equalities
146	  have hs₂ : e₀ y₂ = (v : B) • e₀ y₁ := by rw [hv, map_smul]
147	  have hreg_smul : ∀ (j : D.index) (x : relCurve C B) (hx : x ∈ D.pieces j),
148	      ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) x hx).hom
149	        (D.component ((v : B) • e₀ y₁) j)
150	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk x) :=
151	    D.germ_component_smul_mem_nonZeroDivisors v (e₀ y₁) hreg₁
152	  have hcongr : D.sectionLocalEquations (e₀ y₂) D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
153	        (fun _ => le_rfl) hreg₂
154	      = D.sectionLocalEquations ((v : B) • e₀ y₁) D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
155	        (fun _ => le_rfl) hreg_smul :=
156	    D.sectionLocalEquations_congr hs₂ D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex (fun _ => le_rfl)
157	      hreg₂ hreg_smul
158	  have hchain₁ : Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁
159	      (D.sectionLocalEquations (e₀ y₁) D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
160	        (fun _ => le_rfl) hreg₁) :=
161	    (hdiv₁ D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex fun _ => le_rfl).symm
162	  have hchain₂ : Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq
163	      (D.sectionLocalEquations (e₀ y₁) D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
164	        (fun _ => le_rfl) hreg₁)
165	      (D.sectionLocalEquations ((v : B) • e₀ y₁) D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
166	        (fun _ => le_rfl) hreg_smul) :=
167	    (D.sectionLocalEquations_smul_divEq v (e₀ y₁) D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
168	      (fun _ => le_rfl) hreg₁ hreg_smul).symm
169	  have hchain₃ : Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq
170	      (D.sectionLocalEquations ((v : B) • e₀ y₁) D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
171	        (fun _ => le_rfl) hreg_smul) d₂ :=
172	    hcongr ▸ hdiv₂ D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex fun _ => le_rfl
173	  exact DivFamZarAff.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr (hchain₁.trans (hchain₂.trans hchain₃))
174	
175	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
176	
177	end AlgebraicGeometry

10	# The away-span glue of locally certified classes at CANONICAL carriers
11	
12	The S5b keystone `DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat`
13	(`Picard/DivisorFamilyZarGlue.lean`) glues over an away cover whose carriers `S i` and
14	overlap carriers `T i j` are supplied *as instance data* — eight
15	`Algebra`/`IsScalarTower` fields per index pair.  Every consumer that starts from a
16	bare spanning family `f : Fin m → S`, which is what the atlas factorization
17	`divScheme_exists_chartFactor` (`Picard/DivSchemeAtlasFactor.lean`) hands back, must
18	build that pack itself before it can glue anything.
19	
20	This file builds the pack once, at the **canonical** carriers
21	`Localization.Away (f p)` and `Localization.Away (f p * f q)`, and restates the two
22	keystones so that a consumer holding only `f` and `Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤` can
23	use them:
24	
25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd` — the comparison `k`-algebra map
26	  `Localization.Away a →ₐ[k] Localization.Away f` attached to a factorization
27	  `a * b = f`, from `IsLocalization.Away.lift` at the unit
28	  `algebraMap S (Localization.Away f) a`; `awayMulLeft`/`awayMulRight` are its two
29	  instances at the overlap of a pair.
30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_awaySpan` — **existence**: locally
31	  certified classes `F p` over `Localization.Away (f p)`, agreeing after base change
32	  along `awayMulLeft`/`awayMulRight` into each `Localization.Away (f p * f q)`, glue to
33	  a class over `S` restricting to every `F p`.
34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.eq_of_awaySpan_eq` — **separation** in the same
35	  spelling.
36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.existsUnique_glue_of_awaySpan` — the two combined, in
37	  the `∃!` form the DDR-9 forward map's choice bookkeeping consumes (`w4-ddr9`
38	  worksheet §3.4): it is what makes a glued value independent of every choice made in
39	  producing the cover.
40	
41	Two design points, both deliberate.  The overlap carrier is the canonical
42	`Localization.Away (f p * f q)` rather than a tensor product, which is what makes the
43	instance pack derivable at all: it receives both away carriers by
44	`IsLocalization.Away.lift` against the divisibility witnesses `f p ∣ f p * f q` and
45	`f q ∣ f p * f q`, and the tower coherences then reduce to
46	`IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp` plus the landed `isScalarTower_left_of_isScalarTower`.
47	And the *statements* are spelled with `DivFamZar.mapAlgHom` along an explicit `AlgHom`
48	rather than with the instance-parameterized `DivFamZar.mapAlg`: a caller then needs no
49	algebra instances in scope at all, and the face-change bridge
50	`DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg` moves each hypothesis onto the instance face inside the
51	proof, where the pack is available.
52	-/

76	/-! ## The comparison map into a canonical away localization at a multiple -/
77	
78	/-- **The comparison map of a factorization**: for `a * b = f`, the canonical away
79	localization at `f` receives the one at `a`, because `algebraMap S (Localization.Away f) a`
80	is a unit (`IsLocalization.Away.isUnit_of_dvd`) so `IsLocalization.Away.lift` applies.
81	It is a map of `k`-algebras because both structure maps factor through `S`. -/
82	noncomputable def awayMulOfDvd (f a b : S) (h : a * b = f) :
83	    Localization.Away a →ₐ[k] Localization.Away f :=
84	  { IsLocalization.Away.lift a (S := Localization.Away a)
85	      (g := algebraMap S (Localization.Away f))
86	      (IsLocalization.Away.isUnit_of_dvd (x := f) ⟨b, h.symm⟩) with
87	    commutes' := fun x => by
88	      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k S (Localization.Away a)]
89	      change IsLocalization.Away.lift a _ (algebraMap S (Localization.Away a) _) = _
90	      rw [IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
91	      exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k S (Localization.Away f) x).symm }
92	
93	/-- **The comparison map is the localization lift**: it agrees with
94	`algebraMap S (Localization.Away f)` on `S`, which characterizes it. -/
95	@[simp]
96	theorem awayMulOfDvd_algebraMap (f a b : S) (h : a * b = f) (x : S) :
97	    awayMulOfDvd (k := k) f a b h (algebraMap S (Localization.Away a) x)
98	      = algebraMap S (Localization.Away f) x :=
99	  IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq a
100	    (IsLocalization.Away.isUnit_of_dvd (S := Localization.Away f) (x := f) ⟨b, h.symm⟩) x
101	
102	set_option maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
103	-- The composite is checked against the `IsScalarTower` structure map of the localization,
104	-- which unfolds the section-ring algebra tower on both sides; the defeq check is well
105	-- past the default budget (measured: over 800000 heartbeats).
106	/-- **The comparison map is a map over the base ring**: composing the structure map
107	`S → Localization.Away a` with the comparison into `Localization.Away f` gives the
108	structure map `S → Localization.Away f`.  This is the form consumed when a class pulled
109	back from `S` is compared across two different away localizations. -/
110	theorem awayMulOfDvd_toAlgHom (f a b : S) (h : a * b = f) (x : S) :
111	    awayMulOfDvd (k := k) f a b h (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away a) x)
112	      = IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away f) x :=
113	  IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq a
114	    (IsLocalization.Away.isUnit_of_dvd (S := Localization.Away f) (x := f) ⟨b, h.symm⟩) x

120	/-- The left comparison into the canonical overlap carrier of the pair `(p, q)`. -/
121	noncomputable abbrev awayMulLeft (p q : Fin m) :
122	    Localization.Away (f p) →ₐ[k] Localization.Away (f p * f q) :=
123	  awayMulOfDvd (f p * f q) (f p) (f q) rfl
124	
125	/-- The right comparison into the canonical overlap carrier of the pair `(p, q)`. -/
126	noncomputable abbrev awayMulRight (p q : Fin m) :
127	    Localization.Away (f q) →ₐ[k] Localization.Away (f p * f q) :=
128	  awayMulOfDvd (f p * f q) (f q) (f p) (mul_comm _ _)

135	-- Eight `Algebra`/`IsScalarTower` fields are discharged in the body at the canonical
136	-- carriers, and each unifies the section-ring algebra towers of two away localizations
137	-- at once; the defeq checks exceed the default budget (as in
138	-- `divFamZar.exists_isGlueValue` and `DivRepClassifyZar.exists_isDivRepClassify`).
139	/-- **The away-span glue at canonical carriers**: locally certified divisor classes over
140	the canonical away localizations of a finite spanning family `f`, agreeing after base
141	change along the two comparison maps into each canonical overlap localization
142	`Localization.Away (f p * f q)`, glue to a class over `S` restricting to each of them.
143	
144	This is the S5b keystone `DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat` with its instance pack
145	discharged at the canonical carriers: the overlap carrier receives both away carriers by
146	the comparison maps, the `S`-towers are `awayMulOfDvd_algebraMap`, and the `k`-towers are
147	the `AlgHom` commutation of the same maps.  Hypothesis and conclusion are stated on the
148	explicit `mapAlgHom` face and moved onto the instance face by the face-change bridge
149	`mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg`, so no caller needs the pack. -/
150	theorem exists_glue_of_awaySpan {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → S)
151	    (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤)
152	    (F : ∀ p : Fin m, DivFamZar C (Localization.Away (f p)) π n)
153	    (hcompat : ∀ p q : Fin m,
154	      DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q) (F p)
155	        = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (awayMulRight (k := k) f p q) (F q)) :
156	    ∃ F₀ : DivFamZar C S π n, ∀ p : Fin m,
157	      DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p))) F₀ = F p := by
158	  classical
159	  -- the overlap carrier receives both away carriers, by the two comparison maps
160	  letI algL : ∀ p q : Fin m, Algebra (Localization.Away (f p))
161	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
162	    (awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q).toRingHom.toAlgebra
163	  letI algR : ∀ p q : Fin m, Algebra (Localization.Away (f q))
164	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
165	    (awayMulRight (k := k) f p q).toRingHom.toAlgebra
166	  -- the `S`-towers: each comparison map is the localization lift
167	  haveI towSL : ∀ p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower S (Localization.Away (f p))
168	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
169	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
170	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
171	      exact (awayMulOfDvd_algebraMap (k := k) (f p * f q) (f p) (f q) rfl x).symm)
172	  haveI towSR : ∀ p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower S (Localization.Away (f q))
173	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
174	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
175	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
176	      exact (awayMulOfDvd_algebraMap (k := k) (f p * f q) (f q) (f p)
177	        (mul_comm _ _) x).symm)
178	  -- the `k`-towers: the comparison maps are maps of `k`-algebras
179	  haveI towkL : ∀ p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (f p))
180	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
181	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
182	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
183	      exact ((awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q).commutes x).symm)
184	  haveI towkR : ∀ p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (f q))
185	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
186	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
187	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
188	      exact ((awayMulRight (k := k) f p q).commutes x).symm)
189	  -- the keystone, with the hypothesis transported onto the instance face.  The
190	  -- compatibility proof is deferred with `?_` so that the carrier families are fixed
191	  -- before it elaborates (otherwise `mapAlg`'s instance arguments stay metavariables).
192	  have hkey : ∀ l l' : ULift.{u} (Fin m),
193	      DivFamZar.mapAlg (C := C) (π := π)
194	          (Localization.Away (f l.down * f l'.down)) n (F l.down)
195	        = DivFamZar.mapAlg (C := C) (π := π)
196	          (Localization.Away (f l.down * f l'.down)) n (F l'.down) := by
197	    intro l l'
198	    rw [← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg (awayMulLeft (k := k) f l.down l'.down)
199	        (fun _ => rfl),
200	      ← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg (awayMulRight (k := k) f l.down l'.down)
201	        (fun _ => rfl)]
202	    exact hcompat l.down l'.down
203	  -- the keystone indexes over `Type u`, so the cover is reindexed by `ULift (Fin m)`
204	  obtain ⟨F₀, hF₀⟩ := DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat
205	    (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => f l.down)
206	    (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => Localization.Away (f l.down))
207	    (fun l l' : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => Localization.Away (f l.down * f l'.down))
208	    (by
209	      rw [show (Set.range fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => f l.down) = Set.range f from
210	        ULift.down_surjective.range_comp f]
211	      exact hspan)
212	    (fun l => F l.down) hkey
213	  refine ⟨F₀, fun p => ?_⟩
214	  have hF₀p := hF₀ (ULift.up p)
215	  rw [DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p)))
216	    (fun _ => rfl)]
217	  exact hF₀p
218	
219	/-! ## Separation -/
220	
221	/-- **Separation in the canonical-carrier spelling**: two locally certified classes over
222	`S` agreeing after base change to every `Localization.Away (f p)` of a finite spanning
223	family agree — `DivFamZar.eq_of_away_eq` at the canonical carriers, whose instance pack
224	is the ambient one, with the hypothesis read on the explicit `mapAlgHom` face. -/
225	theorem eq_of_awaySpan_eq {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (f : ι → S)
226	    (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤)
227	    {F G : DivFamZar C S π n}
228	    (h : ∀ p : ι,
229	      DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p))) F
230	        = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p))) G) :
231	    F = G := by
232	  -- the keystone indexes over `Type u`, so the cover is reindexed by `ULift ι`
233	  refine DivFamZar.eq_of_away_eq (fun l : ULift.{u} ι => f l.down)
234	    (fun l : ULift.{u} ι => Localization.Away (f l.down))
235	    (by
236	      rw [show (Set.range fun l : ULift.{u} ι => f l.down) = Set.range f from
237	        ULift.down_surjective.range_comp f]
238	      exact hspan)
239	    (fun l => ?_)
240	  rw [← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg
241	      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f l.down))) (fun _ => rfl) F,
242	    ← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg
243	      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f l.down))) (fun _ => rfl) G]
244	  exact h l.down
245	
246	/-! ## The `∃!` form -/
247	
248	/-- **The away-span glue, uniquely**: the glued class of `exists_glue_of_awaySpan` is the
249	unique class over `S` restricting to the given family, by `eq_of_awaySpan_eq`.
250	
251	**Note what this `∃!` does and does not say.**  It pins the value against *one* cover `f` and
252	*one* family `F`: it says the glue is determined by that data, not that it is independent of
253	the data.  Independence across two different covers is a genuinely separate statement — for
254	the DDR-9 forward map it is `divRepPullGlue_eq_of_chartFactors`
255	(`Picard/DivRepAffPullIndep.lean`), and it needs the overlap agreement, not just separation.
256	An earlier version of this docstring claimed the `∃!` made that argument unnecessary; it does
257	not, and a fresh-context review caught the overclaim. -/
258	theorem existsUnique_glue_of_awaySpan {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → S)
259	    (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤)
260	    (F : ∀ p : Fin m, DivFamZar C (Localization.Away (f p)) π n)
261	    (hcompat : ∀ p q : Fin m,
262	      DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q) (F p)
263	        = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (awayMulRight (k := k) f p q) (F q)) :
264	    ∃! F₀ : DivFamZar C S π n, ∀ p : Fin m,
265	      DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p))) F₀ = F p := by
266	  obtain ⟨F₀, hF₀⟩ := exists_glue_of_awaySpan f hspan F hcompat
267	  exact ⟨F₀, hF₀, fun F₁ hF₁ =>
268	    eq_of_awaySpan_eq f hspan (fun p => (hF₁ p).trans (hF₀ p).symm)⟩
269	
270	end DivFamZar
271	
272	end AlgebraicGeometry

54	def picFromBase (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Subgroup ((C ⊗ T).left.CechPic) :=
55	  (CechPic.map (snd C T).left).range
56	
57	lemma mem_picFromBase_iff {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {L : (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic} :
58	    L ∈ picFromBase C T ↔ ∃ N : T.left.CechPic, CechPic.map (snd C T).left N = L :=
59	  Iff.rfl

61	/-- The relative Picard group of `C/k` at a test object `T`: Picard classes on `C ⊗ T`
62	modulo classes pulled back from `T`. -/
63	def relPic (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Type u :=
64	  (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic ⧸ picFromBase C T
65	
66	noncomputable instance (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : CommGroup (relPic C T) :=
67	  QuotientGroup.Quotient.commGroup (picFromBase C T)
68	
69	/-- The projection from Picard classes on `C ⊗ T` to the relative Picard group. -/
70	noncomputable def relPicMk (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
71	    (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic →* relPic C T :=
72	  QuotientGroup.mk' (picFromBase C T)
73	
74	lemma relPicMk_surjective (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
75	    Function.Surjective (relPicMk C T) :=
76	  QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (picFromBase C T)

79	relative Picard group iff their ratio is pulled back from `T`. -/
80	lemma relPicMk_eq_relPicMk_iff {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
81	    {L L' : (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic} :
82	    relPicMk C T L = relPicMk C T L' ↔ L / L' ∈ picFromBase C T :=
83	  QuotientGroup.eq_iff_div_mem

124	  induction x using relPic.ind with

133	noncomputable def relPicFunctor : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommGrpCat.{u} where
134	  obj T := CommGrpCat.of (relPic C T.unop)

138	    exact relPicMap_id C x
139	  map_comp g h := by
140	    ext x
141	    exact relPicMap_comp C g.unop h.unop x

146	  rfl
147

149	lemma relPicFunctor_map {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ} (g : T ⟶ T')

152	  rfl

154	/-! ## Naturality in the curve -/

156	variable {C} {C' C'' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
157	
158	/-- Pullback of Čech classes along `g ▷ T` sends classes pulled back from `T` to classes

161	    picFromBase C T ≤ (picFromBase C' T).comap (CechPic.map (g ▷ T).left) := by
162	  rintro _ ⟨N, rfl⟩
163	  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
164	  show CechPic.map (snd C' T).left N
165	      = CechPic.map (g ▷ T).left (CechPic.map (snd C T).left N)
166	  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Over.comp_left,
167	    whiskerRight_snd]

169	/-- Restriction of relative Picard classes along a morphism of curves `g : C' ⟶ C`,
170	at a fixed test object: pull back along `g ▷ T` and descend to the quotients. -/
171	noncomputable def relPicMapCurveApp (g : C' ⟶ C) (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
172	    relPic C T →* relPic C' T :=
173	  QuotientGroup.map (picFromBase C T) (picFromBase C' T)
174	    (CechPic.map (g ▷ T).left) (picFromBase_le_comap_whiskerRight g T)

178	    (L : (C ⊗ T).left.CechPic) :
179	    relPicMapCurveApp g T (relPicMk C T L)
180	      = relPicMk C' T (CechPic.map (g ▷ T).left L) :=
181	  QuotientGroup.map_mk' _ _ _ _ L
182	
183	/-- Naturality of the relative Picard functor in the curve: a morphism of curves
184	`g : C' ⟶ C` induces a natural transformation `Pic_{C/k} ⟶ Pic_{C'/k}`. -/
185	noncomputable def relPicMapCurve (g : C' ⟶ C) :
186	    relPicFunctor C ⟶ relPicFunctor C' where
187	  app T := CommGrpCat.ofHom (relPicMapCurveApp g T.unop)
188	  naturality T T' t := by
189	    ext x
190	    induction x using relPic.ind with
191	    | mk L =>
192	      show relPicMapCurveApp g T'.unop (relPicMap C t.unop (relPicMk C T.unop L))
193	          = relPicMap C' t.unop (relPicMapCurveApp g T.unop (relPicMk C T.unop L))
194	      rw [relPicMap_mk, relPicMapCurveApp_mk, relPicMapCurveApp_mk, relPicMap_mk]
195	      refine congrArg (relPicMk C' T'.unop) ?_
196	      rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
197	        ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, ← Over.comp_left, ← Over.comp_left, whisker_exchange]
198	
199	@[simp]
200	lemma relPicMapCurve_app_mk (g : C' ⟶ C) (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ)
201	    (L : (C ⊗ T.unop).left.CechPic) :
202	    (relPicMapCurve g).app T (relPicMk C T.unop L)
203	      = relPicMk C' T.unop (CechPic.map (g ▷ T.unop).left L) :=
204	  relPicMapCurveApp_mk g T.unop L

220	    relPicMapCurve (g' ≫ g) = relPicMapCurve g ≫ relPicMapCurve g' := by

9	/-!
10	# Separation of Čech Picard classes along a clopen partition
11	
12	For a scheme `Y` partitioned by the images of finitely-or-infinitely many open
13	immersions `w i : Z i ⟶ Y` with pairwise disjoint ranges covering `Y` (a *clopen
14	partition* — each range is open with open complement), two Čech Picard classes on `Y`
15	agreeing on every piece agree

18	Route: represent both classes on a common pointed cover refined so that the member at
19	`y` lies inside the piece of `y`; the ratio class pulls back to a coboundary on each
20	piece (`CechPic.mk_injective` — refinement injectivity), and the cobounding units
21	descend through the section equivalence of the open immersions
22	(`Scheme.Hom.unitsPreimageEquiv`) to a coboundary on `Y` itself: overlaps of members
23	from different pieces are empty, so only the single-piece coboundary relations matter,
24	and those transport across `w i` by injectivity of pullback on opens inside the range.

27	`AlgebraicGeometry.Over.prPullback_injective` (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Separatedness`).
